geometry_edits.rationale: Keep the wings connected so the mass remains one dominant building while retaining a legible seam.
Make the split more public and court-like without breaking continuity.
Anchor the access edge with a clearer ground datum.
Broaden the ground response so the entry edge reads as occupied and civic.
Keep the spine low so it acts as threshold rather than bulky podium.

graph_edits.rationale: Keep the building continuous while preserving a legible split/entry seam.
Widen the interstice so it reads as a usable public void rather than a thin crack.
Strengthen the street-level threshold and keep the base socially active.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing in all four views: a compact elongated bar with a central notch/split and an articulated roof/upper strip, so it does not fail the one-view-only or cross-view collision gate. The dominant gesture is understandable and the primary/support relationship is present, though the mass still leans somewhat box-like and the section is not yet fully persuasive for neighborhood living. The visible gap and ground articulation do respond to the access edge, but the public void remains modest rather than strongly occupiable. Compared with the references, it resonates most with low-rise courtyard/bridge/terrace neighborhood buildings, especially in the use of a central void and connected wings, but it is less resolved than the strongest precedents. Overall it is program-plausible and salvageable, with the main weakness being insufficiently expressive section/public-threshold logic rather than typology mismatch.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a central court/void and an upper bridge-like connector; good match for a neighborhood threshold building.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More campus-like and multi-building than this compact single-mass candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced low-rise blocks around a shared public center; useful for balancing hierarchy and collective open space.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Reference is more transparent and site-expansive than the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elongated low-rise mass with a carved central void and folded roof logic; useful for active ground and horizontal spread.
Spread-out composition with connecting circulation and terrace-like section; supports a calm upper mass over an active base.
Interlocking volumes with a large courtyard and elevated voids; useful for clear hierarchy and public threshold formation.

warnings: Parcel containment was not deterministically verifiable from the provided image alone; assuming containment appears acceptable in-view.
Access-edge response is present but only moderate; the street-facing void/seam could be made more explicit.
The silhouette is coherent, but the roof/section remains comparatively plain for the program contract.
